headline: Exchange Outflow Widens To 695.8 Million Dollars From 401.1 Million
narrative: Clean-asset outflow across 79 exchanges widened to 695.8 million dollars from 401.1 million dollars, equal to 0.2578 percent of the 269.9 billion dollars held on those venues. A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue, sell-side supply, and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Binance sent out 649.5 million dollars, Crypto.com sent out 28.6 million dollars, and KuCoin sent out 18.6 million dollars, while Bitfinex took in 14.5 million dollars.
author: jordan
